cards.name: Hapatra's Mark
cards.oracleText: Target creature you control gains hexproof until end of turn. Remove all -1/-1 counters from it. (A creature with hexproof can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)

cards.name: Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons
cards.oracleText:
Whenever Hapatra deals combat damage to a player, you may put a -1/-1 counter on target creature.
Whenever you put one or more -1/-1 counters on a creature, create a 1/1 green Snake creature token with deathtouch.

cards.name: Hapato's Might
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is a number from 0 to 6 chosen at random.
